title: Connector chat assignment, status and versions
description: The control frames that start and stop a chat's daemon on a machine and report where it is (C-05.26). Starting and stopping is desired state, contract 06's assignment, never an imperative command; the rules come from the portal's start route (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/portal/start.js: by id only, never a path, rate limited, audited, wait for readiness) moved into contract 06.

chat_assign.description: Where one chat should be on this machine (C-05.26): contract 06's assignment, with the hub's ring cursor for it (contract 07, C-07.10). Sent for every chat placed on the machine after each hello.ack, and on every new rev. Re-sending a rev already applied is harmless. Direction: hub to connector.

ch.description: The channel this frame travels on (C-05.10).

kind.description: The frame kind within its channel.

id.description: This frame's id, unique per sender per connection. A reply names it in `re`.

seq.description: Per connection, per channel, per direction: 1 for the first frame, plus 1 for each next (C-05.11). Durable positions live in the bodies (contract 07 cursors, hub_msg_id, contract 06 rev), never here.

at.description: When the sender built the frame. Informative; never used for ordering or expiry.

assignment.description: Contract 06's assignment body: scope, desired state (running, stopped, removed), stop mode, agent, origins.

cursor.description: The hub's durable source cursor for this chat's main ring (contract 07, C-07.10).

chat_status.description: Where one chat is (C-05.26): contract 06's status body. Sent on every change, for every supervised chat after each hello.ack, and in answer to a chat.assign (with `re`). Direction: connector to hub.
